name: Promazine
summary: Promazine (brand name Sparine among others), is used as a short-term add-on treatment for psychomotor agitation. Its approved uses in people is limited, but is used as a tranquilizer in veterinary medicine. It has weak antipsychotic effects but is generally not used to treat psychosis.

pharmacology.text: It has predominantly anticholinergic side effects, though extrapyramidal side effects are not uncommon.

uses.text: Promazine (brand name Sparine among others), is used as a short-term add-on treatment for psychomotor agitation. Its approved uses in people is limited, but is used as a tranquilizer in veterinary medicine. Promazine was approved for medical use in the United States in the 1950s, although it is no longer commercially available there.

sideEffects.text: It has predominantly anticholinergic side effects, though extrapyramidal side effects are not uncommon.
